question: What are the drivetrain RPM and timing steps in FS-AI Static Inspection A?
reference_answer: Cite IN2.2.2 (p.16): sweep steering ending straight; ramp to 200 rpm in 10 s, stop <= 5 s, set AS Finished.

question: How is Static Inspection B triggered and what VCU state must result?
reference_answer: Cite IN2.2.2 (p.16): spin drivetrain to 50 rpm, trigger EBS, verify AS Emergency.

question: Summarize the driving sequence required in the Autonomous Demonstration Mission Inspection.
reference_answer: Cite IN2.3.2 (pp.16-17): sweep steering and return straight, drive >= 10 m, stop <= 10 m, drive 10 m, deploy EBS, stay in cones.

question: Compare DOO, Off-Course (OC), and Unsafe Stop (USS) penalties across Acceleration, Skidpad, Autocross, and Trackdrive.
reference_answer: Cite D9.1.6/D9.1.7 (p.34): DOO 0.2 s Skidpad / 2 s others; OC DNF Accel/Skidpad / 10 s others; USS -50 pts Trackdrive (D8.4.3) / DNF others.

question: Can our agent tune planner weights between consecutive Trackdrive or Autocross runs using the previous run's rosbag?
reference_answer: Prohibit auto-feedback: cite D6.3.2 (p.31) and D8.2.4 (p.33) barring prior run/track/dynamic data reuse (deletion proof may be requested).

question: Does the FS-AI track marshal signal the final lap of Trackdrive?
reference_answer: Cite D8.2.7-D8.2.8 (p.33): No — vehicle counts 10 laps autonomously and stops within 30 m after finish into AS Finished.

question: What handshake timing requirement governs ADS-DV AI-to-VCU supervision, and can our agent sit in that path?
reference_answer: Cite T1.1.8 (p.11), T4.2.1-T4.2.2 (p.13), FS-AI_API: 50 ms handshake (10 ms diagnostic rec.); off-vehicle agent has zero write path.

question: Can our agent stream commands or depend on live cloud connectivity at the dynamic start area or BPP room?
reference_answer: No: cite D1.3.1 (p.27) banning start-area vehicle telemetry/commands plus T4.5.1 (p.14) / S2.3.8 (p.19) on no guaranteed internet.

question: What are the page limits and format requirements for the ASF and the ADR?
reference_answer: Cite T4.4.4 (p.14): ASF body 8 pages (T4.4.2 items); S3.3.4-S3.3.6 (p.20): ADR 5 pages, scientific paper format.

question: What happens if we are 12 minutes late to BPP, speak 11.5 minutes, or cannot explain AI-assisted design work?
reference_answer: Cite S2.2.3 (>11 min late = 0 pts), S2.3.4 (9-11 min window; cut off >11 min) (p.18), S3.6.3 (p.21) deductions if unable to explain.

question: Compare our onboard ADS-DV hardware, our trackside competition laptop, and our benchmarking workstation.
reference_answer: Cite sections 2.1 and 4.2: onboard Jetson AGX Xavier (32 GB LPDDR4x) + In-Car PC (i7-8700T, GTX 1060 Ti, 32 GB DDR4, PEAK CAN); laptop RTX 5050 (8 GB VRAM, 16 GB RAM); 24 GB desktop lab-only.

question: Which subteams own CAN-to-Supervisor integration, Git/CI workflows, and simulation, and how are Agentic AI execution lanes partitioned?
reference_answer: Cite sections 2.1 and 11: PSI (3 members) owns CAN/Supervisor/PIT; CI Team (2) owns Git/CI; Simulation (4) owns CARLA/Gazebo; Agentic AI (3) splits into Data & Retrieval, Agents & Tools, and Evaluation & Interface lanes.

question: What is our confirmed vector DB, embedding/reranker, gateway, and tracing stack for P1?
reference_answer: PostgreSQL + pgvector 0.8 (Qdrant fallback), BAAI/bge-m3 + bge-reranker-v2-m3, LiteLLM + Ollama / llama.cpp, Langfuse + OTel.

question: Compare Rank #1 and Rank #3 in the routed two-model monthly cost analysis at 53.80 EGP/USD.
reference_answer: Cite section 7.1: at 53.80 EGP/USD, Rank #1 (gpt-6.2-sol + opus-5-5) and Rank #3 (sonnet-5-5 + opus-5-5, one ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) both estimate $111.98/mo (6,024.26 EGP) for 2,840 calls + 10% buffer.

question: Why is the 3-4B class safer than Qwen3.5-9B Q4 for trackside offline inference on the RTX 5050 Laptop?

question: Which document parser runs by default, and when is LlamaParse allowed?
